text: Left alone, write_data() decides : parquet Arrow can represent object, .parquetlist folder list, .Rds otherwise. type argument overrides . takes one several parquet, rds, tsv, csv txt. files written. returned path first type : point ordering. pipeline stays fast parquet file, .tsv collaborator can open lands beside without second line code. small table ever needs human-readable, type = "tsv" job: .txt written tab-separated, .csv comma-separated.
